name: @rbt/pdf
description: Fable-compiled PDF viewer for browser applications

scripts.build:fable: dotnet tool restore && rm -rf dist && dotnet fable Rbt.Pdf.Web --outDir dist --lang JavaScript --noCache
scripts.fable:dev: dotnet tool restore && rm -rf Rbt.Pdf.Web/.generated && dotnet fable Rbt.Pdf.Web --outDir Rbt.Pdf.Web/.generated
scripts.build: pnpm run build:fable && rm -rf assets && mkdir -p assets && cp ../rbt-renderer/NotoSans-Regular.ttf ../rbt-text/unicode/src/Rbt.Unicode/ucd.dat assets/
